siteDescription: An editorial guide to the Mornington Peninsula, rebuilt as a sharper cover page with weekly curation, featured stories, venue picks, and a clear newsletter invitation.

featuredStory.title: The Peninsula in winter: quieter, sharper, worth it
featuredStory.dek: The crowds are gone and the Peninsula is showing a different face. Cellar doors with room to breathe, long lunches without a booking queue, and a coastline that finally feels like yours.

weekendPlanner.title: Winter Peninsula: art, truffles, and a Sunday lunch worth the drive
weekendPlanner.dek: The Peninsula is in its winter groove. Truffle season is running, MPRG's exhibitions are open through August, and Stonier's fire and wine lunch lands on Sunday.

cards.title: Red Hill Truffles, winter truffle hunt, Main Ridge
cards.note: Périgord black season running through to late September. Pizza hunts, lunch bundles, and private hunts available; book direct. Slots for August weekends are filling - book early.

cards.title: Pt Leo Estate Sculpture Park, Merricks
cards.note: Sixty-plus sculptures across the estate's rolling hillside vineyard. A walk that earns a long lunch at Laura or a glass at the cellar door. Open daily through to April 2027.

cards.title: Country Day at Tar Barrel, Mornington
cards.note: Ash King plays his album launch from 12pm–3pm, Hand Over Hammer takes over from 4pm–7pm. Country day drink specials and Sunday Sippers happy hour. Entry fee applies; check the Tar Barrel website before you go.

cards.title: Flinders Truffles, winter truffle hunt, Flinders
cards.note: Guided Périgord black truffle hunts through August on the Flinders farm, with truffle soup and a toastie by the fire. A quieter and more accessible alternative to Main Ridge.
